schema.name: DatadogAuditLogs_CL
schema.description: Datadog platform audit events collected from the Datadog Audit API

columns.name: EventId
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Datadog audit event

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: Resource type of the event (always 'audit')

columns.name: Attributes
columns.description: Full attributes object of the Datadog audit event

columns.name: EventService
columns.description: Datadog service that emitted the audit event

columns.name: AuditDetails
columns.description: Detailed audit event payload

columns.name: Message
columns.description: Human-readable audit event message

columns.name: Tags
columns.description: Tags associated with the audit event

columns.name: Action
columns.description: Action performed in the audit event

columns.name: AuthenticationMethod
columns.description: Authentication method used by the actor

columns.name: EventName
columns.description: Name of the audited event

columns.name: ActorType
columns.description: Type of actor that performed the action

columns.name: OrganizationId
columns.description: Datadog organization identifier

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Identifier of the user that performed the action

columns.name: UserEmail
columns.description: Email address of the user that performed the action

columns.name: UserUuid
columns.description: Datadog UUID of the user that performed the action

columns.name: HttpMethod
columns.description: HTTP method associated with the audit event

columns.name: HttpStatusCode
columns.description: HTTP response status code

columns.name: HttpUrlHost
columns.description: Host of the requested URL

columns.name: HttpUrlPath
columns.description: Path of the requested URL

columns.name: HttpUserAgent
columns.description: User agent associated with the request

columns.name: ClientIp
columns.description: Client IP address associated with the audit event

columns.name: ClientGeo
columns.description: Geolocation details associated with the client IP address

columns.name: RoutePath
columns.description: Datadog route associated with the request

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Status or severity of the audit event

columns.name: EmittedSource
columns.description: Datadog component that emitted the audit event

columns.name: EventTimestamp
columns.description: Timestamp reported by Datadog for the audit event
